embeds.title: BLHA ANNUAL DRAFT
embeds.description: Strategy and planning for the annual draft.

fields.name: THE FORMAT
fields.value: 5 rounds, linear order, starting 14 to 21 days after the NHL Entry Draft. The first Annual Draft is in 2028 (Article XIV).

fields.name: DRAFT ORDER
fields.value: Non-playoff teams pick 1.01 to 1.06 by ascending Potential Points. Picks 1.07 and 1.08 go to the Quarterfinal losers, then fourth place, third place, Runner-Up and Champion.

fields.name: OFFICIAL COMMUNICATION
fields.value: Draft-day notices live in the Draft Center. This room is for strategy.
